featuredProjects.name: Exchange Market Surveillance & Algorithmic Risk Control Platform
featuredProjects.summary: Built a market-surveillance and risk-interception platform for spot and derivatives trading, using DOM, tick trades, cancel behavior, and account graphs to detect spoofing, layering, wash trading, pump-and-dump patterns, and likely manipulator accounts.

metrics.label: joint modeling across book depth, trades, cancels, and account behavior
Logistic Regression / Random Forest / XGBoost / Isolation Forest

details: Built a unified feature table from order-book snapshots, tick trades, order life cycles, and deposit/withdrawal events, repairing out-of-order messages, duplicate events, missing depth levels, and clock drift while generating 1s / 5s / 30s windows.
Engineered 120+ factors around DOM depth shifts, layered quote pressure, cancel hot zones, cancel-to-fill ratio, bid/ask imbalance, sweep paths, slippage, and price impact.
Used Logistic Regression and Random Forest as interpretable baselines, then improved supervised performance with XGBoost and covered sparse-label cold-start cases with Isolation Forest.

Combined account relationship graphs, device/network fingerprints, fund paths, and behavior clustering to identify coordinated manipulation, self-trading rings, and split-account accumulation patterns.
Deployed realtime scoring and threshold tiers with Kafka plus Flink/Go services, while using ClickHouse replay jobs for PSI drift checks and parameter tuning.
featuredProjects.achievement: Moved market surveillance from rule-only detection to a hybrid rule-plus-model workflow, turning manipulator discovery from after-the-fact investigation into minute-level alerting while reducing manual review pressure.

featuredProjects.name: On-chain Entity Profiling & Contract Risk Scoring Engine
featuredProjects.summary: Built an on-chain profiling and risk-scoring system for new-token screening, abnormal fund-path detection, high-privilege contracts, and high-risk address groups across multiple EVM chains.

metrics.label: multi-chain EVM data normalization and risk linkage
address, contract, liquidity, and fund-flow profiling

details: Unified contract source, event logs, token distribution, LP changes, bridge flows, blocklists, and historical incident records into dual entity profiles for wallets and contracts.
Modeled admin rights, tax logic, blacklist controls, liquidity lock status, holder concentration, fund-flow entropy, address co-occurrence, and transaction-time distributions as risk signals.
Used K-Means for cohort segmentation, then Logistic Regression and Gradient Boosting to generate risk scores while sending low-confidence cases back to analysts for relabeling.
Turned audit conclusions, user complaints, historical incidents, and operational handling outcomes into label sources and evaluated models with walk-forward validation plus threshold calibration.
Operationalized the pipeline in Go microservices for multi-chain retrieval, caching, parsing, and structured outputs consumed by ops, customer support, and review teams.
featuredProjects.achievement: Compressed on-chain risk checks from fragmented manual lookup into a unified scoring and alerting workflow that supported pre-listing screening, address review, and coordinated operations response.

featuredProjects.name: Industrial Vision Inspection & 3D Safety Warning Platform
featuredProjects.summary: Led industrial inspection and monocular safety-warning programs end to end, from sampling strategy, labeling standards, and data augmentation through model training, false-positive review, and PLC/mobile deployment.

metrics.label: critical production defects reported as missed
data prep, training, tuning, and deployment

details: Defined sampling and annotation rules, removed noisy images, duplicate frames, and bad labels, and handled class imbalance with augmentation and hard-negative mining.

Combined OpenCV preprocessing with detection, segmentation, and geometric measurement algorithms, then iterated on false-positive analysis to reset thresholds, post-processing, and ROI strategies by scenario.
Added camera calibration, perspective constraints, RANSAC geometric fitting, and 3D reconstruction ideas to improve distance-estimation stability in complex environments.
Systematically tuned learning rates, anchors, IoU thresholds, morphology parameters, and post-processing rules until offline gains translated into stable production behavior.
Integrated outputs into PLC and mobile alert workflows so model decisions could directly drive line actions and field safety warnings.
featuredProjects.achievement: The work mattered because it unified model training, data governance, and deployment discipline into long-lived production systems rather than one-off demos.
